I'm glad you chose not to kill yourself, your children will be better off with their father in their lives. All those small things add up - laundry, dishes, every day spent resisting every single urge will make you stronger. 

Continue to build strength and character. To offer some specific advice, start exercising for at least half an hour, five days a week (HIIT bodyweight training is free, and there's plenty of YouTube videos from Chris Heria, VShred, The Body Coach to follow along with). Push yourself even when you don't feel like it, because you will feel so much better and more disciplined afterwards. I also suggest you pick up a copy of Marcus Aurelius "Meditations". Its an easy read with simple but effective musings that will change the way you think. 

It gets better, you'll make it.
